name: Huda Sha'arawi
contribution: A pioneering Egyptian feminist leader, suffragette, nationalist, and founder of the Egyptian Feminist Union.

checks.lead: Huda Sha'arawi or Hoda Sha'rawi (Arabic: هدى شعراوي, ALA-LC: Hudá Sha‘rāwī; 23 June 1879 – 12 December 1947) was a pioneering Egyptian feminist leader, suffragette, nationalist, and founder of the Egyptian Feminist Union.
